{
  "name": "rjmlaird-labs",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.0.0",
  "volta": {
    "node": "22.23.4",
    "pnpm": "10.0.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "export-builds": "tsx scripts/export-builds.ts",
    "new:experiment": "node scripts/new-experiment.mjs",
    "dev:index": "pnpm --filter labs-index dev",
    "build:index": "pnpm --filter labs-index build",
    "preview:index": "pnpm --filter labs-index preview",
    "dev:exp-example": "pnpm --filter exp-example dev",
    "build": "pnpm -r --if-present run build",
    "check": "pnpm -r --if-present run check",
    "lint": "pnpm -r --if-present run lint",
    "brand:build": "pnpm --filter @rjmlaird/brand build",
    "brand:check": "pnpm --filter @rjmlaird/brand check",
    "audit": "node scripts/brand-audit.mjs",
    "audit:ci": "node scripts/brand-audit.mjs --baseline scripts/brand-audit.baseline.json"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "tsx": "^4.23.15",
    "wrangler": "^4.149.0"
  }
}
